title: Aurora API
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.aurorasolar.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

## Sync API   [Skip link to Sync API](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/\#sync-api)

Scale quickly with real-time, reliable data syncing between Aurora and your existing systems.

Sync API is available starting on our Build plan.

[Start now >](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/reference/aurora-solar-api)

## Design API   [Skip link to Design API](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/\#design-api)

Accelerate deals by triggering the creation of proposal-ready designs in Aurora from anywhere. Endpoints include Fire Pathway Placement, AutoDesigner, Irradiance Analysis, and Performance Simulation.

Design API is available as an add-on to our Build plan or higher.

[Start now >](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/reference/autodesigner)

## Webhooks   [Skip link to Webhooks](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/\#webhooks)

Enable real-time updates across teams and tools with webhooks for key Aurora events.

Sync API is available starting on our Build plan.

[Start now >](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/reference/webhooks)

## Need help getting started?   [Skip link to Need help getting started?](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/\#need-help-getting-started)

If you need help implementing our APIs, please reach out to [developer-support@aurorasolar.com](mailto:developer-support@aurorasolar.com).
